main_text.head: LXIV. LEGATI AD ELECTOREM SAXONIÆ EPISTOLA.
main_text.p: VI. A Prilis misi ad Celsitudinem Vestram literas, quibus conquerebar de iniqua Imperatoris in me voluntate, & de illius Majestatis mandato, ad multos, ut me interciperent. Qua in re ostendebam non civilia tantum sed Divina & Gentium jura violari, cum Serenissi. Regis Navarrensi P jussu

page.notes: The initial "A" is a large woodcut initial joined to "Prilis". The final line is partly illegible at the foot of the page; the word "jussu" is printed at the right end of the last line, and the letter "P" stands on its own before it. The phrase "Serenissi. Regis Navarrensi" may be incomplete in the scan.
